test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of EVM?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Electronic Voting Machine.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Electronic voting machines (EVM) help to **record votes.**
 
• The **Indian electronic voting machine (EVM) **was developed in **1989 by the Election Commission of India.**
 
• EVM supports provide the** basis to assess work progress** against a baseline plan, relate technical, time and cost performance.
 
• The chief cause is EVM requires** a bottom-up approach to defining the full scope of work** by using a **"deliverable-oriented" **WBS focused on end products.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b6e46592e0e9f565cb865f976bfae4db0f7931ff70777a8ccfd592ec7edc018.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The election commission has the right to **permit marks to the political parties.**
 
• It gives identification to the **national parties, state parties, and regional parties**. 
 
• It** sets limitations** on poll expenses. ​ 
 
• The** commission produces electoral rolls **and updates the voter's list from time to time.
